g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: AWS video processing with MediaConvert, Rekognition and CloudFront signed URLs

g.title: None.None.Node.26
g.text: A creator asks the API for an upload URL; Cognito authenticates them
and a Lambda function returns presigned multipart URLs
The creator uploads the master file straight to S3
EventBridge starts the Step Functions workflow
which probes the file for codec and length
MediaConvert writes an adaptive bitrate ladder
Rekognition checks the content and tags it
and the video is published to the catalogue, with SNS telling the creator
A member browses the catalogue through the API
and signs a short-lived CloudFront URL with the key in Secrets Manager
The player streams from CloudFront, which checks the signature
and serves HLS segments from S3 through origin access control
